{{Top|leg}}
An '''agility upgrade''' was a module that increased the agility of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] by creating new programs to run its motivators in order to increase the droid's reaction time.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
